statement: GX-21: errors when the files touch the units of several lanes (the lane is undecidable and the train would refuse it), listing each unit with its lane.
note: Seeded by scripts/model seed-rules (PADRAO-DEV F1b); its statement and types are to be reviewed. No basis: GX-21 (docs/units/GX21) defined "lane undecidable" itself; the D-112 in the body is about retired units, and D-065 (4) / D-067 (2) give each unit one exclusive lane but do not state that a change touching several lanes is refused.
